content.value: Air at $2 5 \mathrm { { } ^ { \circ } C }$ flows over a tube bank consisting of 2.5 cm-OD, 2–m long tubes in inline arrangement with $S _ { L } / D = 1 . 5$ and $S _ { T } / D = 2$ The tube bank is 10 rows deep, forming a stack 20 tubes high. The air velocity before entering the tube bank is $u _ { \infty } =$ 10 m/s. The tubes are maintained at a uniform temperature of $1 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ . Determine the average friction factor and the pressure drop for the flow across the tube bank.
